name: hypotize
description: The agent-native Growth OS: turns your AI agent into a disciplined growth hacker, with a scored backlog, an enforced lifecycle and a queryable record of learnings.

interface.longDescription:
Hypotize is a growth experiment tracker for growth, product and marketing teams: an agent-native Growth OS that holds the whole growth loop in one place: the idea backlog, prioritization, the experiment pipeline, results and the library of learnings. Your team works in the web app. ChatGPT works on the same record through this plugin.

With Hypotize connected, ChatGPT reads what the team already tested before proposing anything new. It turns raw ideas into hypothesis-first experiments, scores them with ICE, PIE, RICE or your own framework, writes the action plan and moves each experiment through its stages: Idea, Approved, Ready, Running, Analyzing, then a measured outcome. When a test ends, it records the result and the learning, so the next conversation starts from what you already know.

Built for teams. Teammates vote on ideas and comment on experiments, and ChatGPT can do both for you. Each product or market lives in its own project.

The server enforces the method. An experiment cannot skip a stage or close without a result and a learning, whether a person or ChatGPT is writing. ChatGPT acts with your role in each project. Delete access stays off unless you grant it when connecting, and ChatGPT never touches billing or members.

The plugin includes three skills: the experiment method, a read-only weekly pipeline review and a backlog import from a spreadsheet or a Notion export.

Getting started: sign in with Google or email when you connect.

Hypotize does not assign traffic or run A/B tests. Keep your analytics and experimentation tools. Hypotize keeps the record before and after.
